name: Village of Larchmont
gaps: FAR and lot coverage are step functions ('per 1,000 sf or part thereof'); band edges set at x,001 sf. § 381-38's illustrative table uses the unrounded formula below 5,000 sf
Side yards increase with house size (§ 381-37D) in R-5, R-7.5, R-10, R-12.5, R-15, R-30 and W; only noted, not modeled
Schedule sets no minimum frontage or lot depth
No accessory apartment / ADU use in the Schedule of Use Regulations
No private-property tree removal permit in Ch. 263; no standalone steep slope law (retaining walls and grade changes regulated in §§ 381-41H, 381-42)
W district is not marked residential in the county list but allows one-family houses, so it is included

wetlands.summary: Ch. 341: controlled areas are wetlands plus adjacent land less than 2 ft above the 10-year high-water mark, and rainfall drainage systems (watercourses) plus the greater of land within 100 ft or less than 5 ft above the 10-year high-water mark; activities there need a permit.

steep_slopes.summary: No steep slope chapter; retaining walls (§ 381-41H) and grade changes/soil import-export (§ 381-42: max 1/2 ft x lot area in cubic yards, 25 cy as of right) are limited on one-family lots.

trees.summary: Ch. 263 covers street/park trees and hazardous private trees only; tree removal tied to site plan work is penalized under § 381-68-N.

stormwater.summary: Ch. 335: land development activity disturbing 500 sf or more needs a stormwater pollution prevention plan and Village review.

adu.summary: No accessory apartment use; up to two boarders or roomers allowed in residence districts (Schedule of Use Regulations).

general.accessory_structures: Accessory buildings 5 ft from side/rear lines, 13 ft high (10 ft flat roof), 1.5 stories, 5-8% lot coverage by district, not in front/side-front yards, 10 ft from the house; detached garages by special permit, 6 ft from side/rear lines and 30 ft from streets. Decks only behind the house, max 12 ft deep, outside required yards.
general.pools: Special permit; rear yard only on lots of 5,000 sf+, meeting district side/rear setbacks (as increased by § 381-37), counted in lot coverage, 15 ft from any structure, 4 ft barrier (§ 381-55C).
general.notes: One-family height: max 30 ft at any point around the building, measured from the lower of existing or proposed grade to the mean of eaves and ridge; 20 ft height at the side/rear setback line rising 2 ft (3 ft in R-7.5/R-5) per extra foot of setback (§ 381-34).

R-30.name: R-30 One-Family Residence

max_building_coverage.note: Principal building only; accessory buildings may cover another 5%

max_impervious_coverage.note: § 381-38 lot coverage: buildings, structures, driveways, walkways, patios, pools, courts and other paved/man-made surfaces. Bands apply the 'or part thereof' wording; the code's illustrative table gives 52.5% at 4,000 sf (linear formula) where the steps give 53%.

max_floor_area.note: § 381-37B gross residential FAR for one-family dwellings: 0.64 up to 4,000 sf, -0.02 per 1,000 sf (or part) to 0.42 at 15,000, -0.01 per 1,000 to 0.37 at 20,000, -0.005 per 1,000 to 0.32 at 30,000+. Includes accessory buildings, basements, cellars and attics; excludes decks/patios, unenclosed porches, spaces under 5 ft headroom, and a 400/500/600 sf below-grade basement allowance (lots <=5,000 / <=7,500 / larger).

accessory.notes: Accessory buildings: 5 ft from side and rear lot lines, max 5% of the lot, 13 ft (10 ft flat roof), 1.5 stories; not in the front, side (except its rear portion) or side-front yard; 10 ft from the house (§ 381-40). Detached garages (special permit): 6 ft from side/rear lines and 30 ft from any street line (§ 381-55A).

R-30.notes: Both side yards grow 1/4 ft per 100 sf of gross residential floor area over 6,000 sf, up to 20 ft more per side (§ 381-37D). Front/side-front yard may be reduced to the average of the nearest four houses on the block (Schedule note 5, § 381-33A). Height also limited by a 20 ft height-setback plane at the side/rear setback lines (§ 381-34C).
